author: ernesttheaiguy
text: The Alpine OpenSSH flaw needs musl, no PAM, OpenSSH before 10.6p2, a SHA-hashed account and an asterisk shadow entry. Narrow does not mean safe. Exploitation reports led CISA to add CVE-2026-123158 to KEV.

author: 605mediallc
text:
CISA has added an OpenSSH flaw dubbed "SSHole" to its list of actively exploited vulnerabilities. Takeaway: check your distro's advisory, patch OpenSSH, and limit SSH exposure (VPN or IP allowlist, keys only). 🔐
https://t.co/JyX5NLjQUa

author: BXAR_Sec
text: sshole (CVE-2026-123158): musl crypt() returns "*" for keys over 256 bytes, which is also what Alpine stores for a passwordless account. So an overlong password authenticates. Patched in OpenSSH 10.6p2. On the CISA KEV list. Audit your base images. #offensivesecurity #pentesting
